title: Comparisons to Earlier Versions
summary: Reviews compare the G60 with earlier BMW versions, praising improved comfort, driving feel, and brand evolution while also noting one complaint about the new iDrive knob and some speculative remarks about future versions.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the G60 feels like a successful evolution over earlier versions, with better comfort, strong driving feel, simple recharging, and alignment with what owners hoped BMW would become.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize the new iDrive knob as working worse than older versions.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention the car surpassing earlier versions or interest in how later versions will evolve, but they are too vague or speculative to assign clear sentiment in this topic sample.

limitations: The sample is small and stratified, so it does not show how common these comparisons are among all G60 reviews.
One positive example mentions avoiding a material on future versions, which makes the cluster partially about future design choices rather than only direct comparisons with earlier versions.
The undetermined examples are brief and lack enough detail to clarify which specific vehicle aspects are being compared.
